rejected.name: Standalone institutional sales
rejected.note: Sales coverage was considered separately but is embedded in each product-market division because client coverage, quoting and execution are organized by rates, FX, credit, equities, commodities and securitised-product franchises.

rejected.name: Standalone cross-asset structuring
rejected.note: Structuring was considered as a separate division but is included within the relevant rates, FX, credit, equities, commodities and securitised-product divisions to avoid double counting the same seats and revenue disclosures.

rejected.canon: electronic market making as an independent division
rejected.name: Electronic market-making as an independent division
rejected.note: Electronic execution is an operating channel used by the rates, FX, credit and equities divisions rather than a consistently disclosed product division.

rejected.name: Corporate lending
rejected.note: Relationship loans and traditional revolving-credit facilities belong primarily to corporate banking unless directly attached to underwriting, syndication or markets financing.

rejected.name: Transaction banking and payments
rejected.note: Cash management, merchant acquiring and ordinary payments are separately disclosed banking services rather than capital-markets or global-markets operations.

rejected.canon: retail brokerage mass market wealth advice
rejected.name: Retail brokerage and mass-market wealth advice
rejected.note: Retail brokerage and personal financial advice are wealth-management activities, and the principal adviser seat is predominantly relationship and suitability judgement work.

rejected.name: Issuer investor relations
rejected.note: Investor relations is ordinarily an issuer function rather than a division of the G-SIB or institutional buy-side counterparty, and its organizational boundary is not stable across issuers.

rejected.name: Central bank treasury and liquidity management
rejected.note: Bank treasury executes in capital markets but principally manages the bank's own funding, liquidity and interest-rate profile rather than operating the client-facing capital-markets franchise.

rejected.name: General legal and compliance
rejected.note: Product-specific compliance tasks are anchored in the admitted divisions, while enterprise legal and compliance functions cannot be allocated to capital markets without unstable organizational assumptions.

rejected.name: Corporate access and investor conferences
rejected.note: The principal work is relationship coordination and discretionary meeting facilitation; the determinable fraction is too low for the midpoint fully-loaded seat cost to produce addressable seat cost of at least USD 200000.

rejected.name: Physical commodity ownership and merchant logistics
rejected.note: G-SIB participation differs materially by jurisdiction and bank, and no stable segment mapping distinct from commodities markets was sufficiently certain.

rejected.name: Standalone sovereign advisory
rejected.note: The activity is usually embedded in investment banking or public-sector coverage, and a distinct published market-size series and G-SIB line-item mapping could not both be established confidently.

rejected.name: Alternative-investment private equity ownership
rejected.note: Post-Volcker organizational models vary substantially among G-SIBs, and principal investing, third-party alternatives management and legacy balance-sheet investments are not a single stable operational division.

rejected.canon: custody security service as a standalone division
rejected.name: Custody and securities services as a standalone division
rejected.note: Custody is a canonical adjacent G-SIB business with strong regulatory and segment anchors, but ordinary custody-processing seats have a lower midpoint fully-loaded cost than specialist markets operations; after applying the determinable fraction, the candidate did not reliably clear the USD 200000 admission threshold.

rejected.name: Mergers and acquisitions advisory
rejected.note: Considered adjacent investment banking, but negotiation, client judgment and relationship work dominate; treated as outside the canonical capital-markets operating set used here.

rejected.name: Standalone fundamental research publishing
rejected.note: Research supports markets, but thesis formation is predominantly discretionary and the determinable share does not reliably produce at least USD 200,000 of addressable seat cost.

rejected.name: Generic trade operations and settlements
rejected.note: The work has strong terminality, but typical fully loaded operations-seat economics fall below the admission threshold after applying the determinable fraction.

rejected.name: Regulatory compliance and financial-crime monitoring
rejected.note: These are enterprise control functions rather than canonical capital-markets or global-markets divisions, even when they support trading activity.

rejected.name: Custody and fund administration
rejected.note: Core custody is primarily securities services, and collateral or prime-brokerage components are already represented in admitted financing divisions.

rejected.name: Standalone sales coverage
rejected.note: Pure relationship coverage is relationally dominant; product sales roles are instead included with their respective rates, credit, FX, equities, commodities and financing desks.

rejected.name: Corporate treasury and asset-liability management
rejected.note: Bank treasury is principally an enterprise balance-sheet function; its market-facing secured-funding and hedging activities are captured in rates and repo/collateral financing.

rejected.name: Retail brokerage and wealth-adviser distribution
rejected.note: Retail distribution belongs primarily to wealth management and is materially driven by suitability, advice and customer relationships.

rejected.canon: proprietary trading as a standalone bank division
rejected.name: Proprietary trading as a standalone bank division
rejected.note: Post-Volcker G-SIB disclosures generally do not support a stable standalone proprietary-trading division distinct from permitted market making, underwriting and risk management.

rejected.name: Digital-asset and cryptocurrency markets
rejected.note: As of 2025, bank organisational boundaries and jurisdictional classifications remain inconsistent, and no stable G-SIB segment line item isolates the candidate division.

rejected.name: Clearing as a standalone division
rejected.note: Clearing is operationally important, but many clearing seats do not meet the cost threshold; higher-value margin and financing functions are included in prime brokerage and collateral financing.

rejected.name: Capital-markets legal documentation
rejected.note: Legal documentation is a support function rather than a canonical revenue or counterparty division, and the blended addressable seat economics are not reliably above the threshold.

rejected.name: Corporate mergers and acquisitions advisory
rejected.note: Considered as an adjacent investment-banking activity, but negotiation, board advice and discretionary strategic judgment dominate the operating model; it is not a canonical markets execution or intermediation division under the requested determinability screen.

rejected.name: Private wealth advisory
rejected.note: Primarily a wealth-distribution and relationship-management activity rather than wholesale capital-markets intermediation.

rejected.name: Retail brokerage and self-directed investing
rejected.note: Retail distribution was considered but excluded from the wholesale global-markets perimeter; typical service-seat addressable cost also falls below the admission threshold.

rejected.name: Custody-only asset servicing
rejected.note: Core custody processing largely overlaps Markets post-trade operations, while a separately defined custody-service seat generally does not meet the required addressable-seat-cost threshold.

rejected.name: Corporate commercial lending
rejected.note: Relationship lending and loan-book management are banking activities adjacent to, but distinct from, canonical capital-markets and global-markets operations.

rejected.name: Investor relations and corporate communications
rejected.note: These are corporate functions rather than sell-side markets operations or buy-side counterpart functions.

rejected.name: Standalone market-data administration
rejected.note: Market-data administration is distributed across technology, operations and procurement, lacks a stable bank-wide divisional definition and generally falls below the seat-cost threshold.

rejected.name: Legal documentation counsel
rejected.note: Markets legal work is important but is normally organized as a legal coverage function rather than a canonical revenue or operating division; bespoke negotiation is substantial.

rejected.name: Financial-crime transaction monitoring
rejected.note: A bank-wide compliance utility rather than a capital-markets division; the typical monitoring-investigator seat does not satisfy the addressable-cost threshold.

rejected.name: Index administration
rejected.note: Some G-SIBs calculate proprietary indices, but a distinct published segment mapping and consistently separable market-size series could not be established with sufficient confidence.

rejected.name: Carbon-credit project origination
rejected.note: Project origination and voluntary-credit intermediation remain inconsistently defined across banks and jurisdictions; they are retained within broader commodities coverage rather than admitted separately.
